title: PICID: Proof-Driven Clause Learning in Neural Network Verification
abstract: arXiv:2503.12083v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Current Deep Neural Network (DNN) verifiers are typically designed to prioritize scalability over reliability. Reliability can be reinforced through the generation of proofs that are checkable by trusted, external proof checkers. To date, only a handful of verifiers support proof production; and these rely on verifier-specific formats, and balance between scalability, proof detail, and the trustworthiness of their proof checker. In this tool paper, we introduce PICID, a DNN verifier that produces proofs in the standard Alethe format for SMT solving, checkable by an independent checker. PICID implements a parallel CDCL(T) architecture that integrates the state-of-the-art, proof-producing CaDiCaL SAT solver with the Marabou DNN verifier. translated_title: PICID：神经网络验证中的证明驱动子句学习
translated_abstract: 当前的深度神经网络（DNN）验证器通常被设计为优先考虑可扩展性而非可靠性。可靠性可以通过生成可由受信任的外部证明检查器验证的证明来加强。迄今为止，只有少数验证器支持证明生成；而这些验证器依赖于特定于验证器的格式，并在可扩展性、证明细节和其证明检查器的可信度之间进行权衡。在本工具论文中，我们介绍了PICID，一个以SMT求解的标准Alethe格式生成证明、且可由独立检查器验证的DNN验证器。PICID实现了一个并行CDCL(T)架构，将最先进的、可生成证明的CaDiCaL SAT求解器与Marabou DNN验证器集成在一起。此外，PICID利用UNSAT证明来推导冲突子句。我们的评估表明，PICID在绝大多数情况下生成有效证明，并显著优于现有工具。
tldr: PICID通过并行CDCL(T)架构将CaDiCaL SAT求解器与Marabou验证器集成，以标准Alethe格式生成可独立验证的证明，并利用UNSAT证明推导冲突子句，从而同时兼顾验证的可靠性与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: PICID is a DNN verifier that integrates the CaDiCaL SAT solver with the Marabou verifier through a parallel CDCL(T) architecture, producing proofs in the standard Alethe format checkable by an independent checker, and leveraging UNSAT proofs to derive conflict clauses for both reliability and scalability.
